g.text: TEST / LOW-PRECISION REGENERATION - not final validation
Zero values have a separate non-log bin and remain in all counts. No p-values are clipped or discarded.
Geometric-bin counts are not a uniform-density diagnostic. Performance is conditional on this simulation model.
